==About==

2x {{i|Wild Turkey Breast}}s are received when Cutting Up a {{i|Stuffed Wild Turkey}}. Additionally a Wild Turkey Breast can be obtained by baking a {{i|Raw Turkey Breast}} in {{i|Any Stove}}.
